summary.text: Josh Hernandez, listed by Ballotpedia as Joshua Hernandez, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 60 since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a digital marketing manager.

paragraphs.text: Hernandez was born in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and his career experience includes working as a digital marketing manager for Agenda.
The Republican Sandoval County Central Committee chose him to replace Timothy Lewis on the 2020 election ballot after Lewis withdrew from the general election.
